messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown in the reference images, using the first reference for the front view and the second reference for the back view. The target outfit consists of the bottoms, the top, the outerwear, and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the bottoms, the top, the outerwear, and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, turns slightly to the side, and then faces forward again.","camera":"A static medium-long shot from behind the character at a low angle.","clothing":"A loose pink short-sleeved top, dark brown shorts, and red-and-white sneakers.","hair_color":"Light brown.","hairstyle":"Light brown hair tied into two low pigtails.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, seen from behind.","scene":"A cobblestone street in a European-style town with brick buildings, shop awnings, street lamps, and a Union Jack flag hanging overhead."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original pink long-sleeved dress and black boots were replaced with a loose pink short-sleeved top, dark brown shorts, and red-and-white sneakers. The character's hair, body, pose, street scene, and camera framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the character's entire outfit with the reference outfit: pink short-sleeved top/outerwear, bottoms, and matching footwear, removing all original clothing and shoes while preserving non-clothing attributes.
uncertain: Whether the dark brown shorts are the intended bottoms from the reference or a substitute, because the reference images do not clearly show separate bottoms.
unexpected_changes: The reference's floral bikini-style undergarment is not visible in the output.
